seoTitle: Business Name Idea Generator From Your Keywords
metaDescription: Turn one to three keywords into dozens of business name ideas with prefixes, suffixes and blends. Does not check domains or trademarks.
intro: Combines your keywords with common prefixes, suffixes and blends into a list of name ideas.
why:
A list of options is a starting point. Reading dozens of combinations helps you see which sound you like, even when the final name is something different.

The list is deterministic, so the same keywords give the same list. The tool does not check domain names, trademarks, social handles or meaning in other languages, and a catchy name may already be taken. Do those checks before you commit.
howTo: Enter one to three keywords, one per line.
Set the longest name you want.
Scan the list and shortlist favourites.
